items.text: Arizona RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is not expected to play.
Arizona S Budda Baker, DL Walter Nolen III, CB Garrett Williams and S Andrew Wingard did not practice Wednesday; RB James Conner and OT Paris Johnson are on IR. Jacoby Brissett starts.
Denver S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) and OLB Jonah Elliss did not practice Wednesday; CB Pat Surtain II (ankle) returned limited and RB Jonah Coleman returned from IR. WR Pat Bryant is on IR.
